findings.title: recursion guard's merge-side half is asserted nowhere — only the check and ci-local's export are
kernel.md/configuration.md say `merge_gate` is "read from repo config ONLY", but `config_get` honours `ORCHID_MERGE_GATE` ahead of repo config
`runners/orchid-drive` reports every post-merge rework as "merge validation failed", so the `gate_failed` distinction PROTOCOL.md now mandates is never briefed by the shipped orchestrator
ci-local exports the marker process-wide for every invocation, so under hosted CI the whole suite runs gate-disabled and only test_merge.sh opts back in
